note: Both sets capture the figure's material legend and the CG/GC/NA/SC marker labels, but Set A binds the 70% span cross-section location to the correct supporting quote ('Blade cross section at 70% span'), whereas Set B attaches a non-supporting quote ('Blade: IEA 15MW...; Section : 0.7') to that claim. Set B also introduces contradictory coordinate values (CG x3 = 0.0 vs 0.1 m and GC x3 = 0.0 vs 0.05 m) that cannot both be right, plus an unverified NA x3 value. Set A's weaknesses are mainly redundancy (duplicate GC x2 and repeated material entries) and a doubtful SC x2 = -0.2 m reading, but it invents no conflicting values. Overall Set A is the more faithful extraction.
